title: Deathlipse Logo T-shirt, Gothic Graphic Tee, Dark Moon Eclipse Top, Unisex Softstyle Shirt, Alternative Clothing, Occult Fashion
description:
A Deathlipse logo t-shirt that exudes a cool and edgy vibe, perfect for casual wear or as a statement piece. Ideal for fans of alternative style and graphic tees, this unisex t-shirt is made for year-round comfort and versatility. Great for holidays, concerts, or everyday streetwear.

Product features
- Made from 100% ring-spun cotton for durability and smoothness
- Classic fit with crew neckline for a clean, versatile style
- Ethically grown and harvested US cotton for sustainability
- Ribbed knit collar for shape retention
- Available in various fabric blends for different color options

Care instructions
- Do not dryclean
- Machine wash: warm (max 40C or 105F)
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Iron, steam or dry: low heat
